ideas.title: Daycare Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of daycare fraud in Minnesota and other states, and explore the impact on vulnerable populations.
questions: What is the extent of daycare fraud in Minnesota?
How do these fraud schemes work?
ideas.insight: I believe that daycare fraud is a significant issue that requires further investigation. By following the money and exploring the impact on vulnerable populations, we can shed light on this critical issue.

ideas.title: Federal Funding: A Critical Issue
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's handling of federal funds, including potential cuts to mental health and addiction grants.
questions: What are the potential consequences of federal funding cuts?
How will these cuts impact vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: I believe that federal funding is a critical issue that requires further investigation. By analyzing data and exploring the potential consequences of funding cuts, we can better understand the impact on vulnerable populations.
